objective: Implement and directly verify the legal M427r3 survivor: one atomic low8/high4 dual-bank co-read reconstructs one complete signed12x96 PWP delta. The adapter is standalone and its delta is added later by the existing accumulator to old PSUM.

semantic_contract.atomic_request: One request carries both low[767:0] and high[511:0].
semantic_contract.narrow: The 96 signed8 low lanes are sign-extended to signed12. The complete high-side data and duplicated metadata must be zero.
semantic_contract.wide: Each signed12 lane is reconstructed exactly as {high4,low8}; high[511:384] is physical padding and must be zero; duplicated high-side metadata must equal low-side metadata.
semantic_contract.elasticity: One registered output entry supports simultaneous pop plus push and II=1 when downstream ready is sustained.
semantic_contract.accumulation: The output is update_delta only. Downstream performs new_psum=old_psum+update_delta.

illegal_conditions: narrow nonzero high-side data or metadata
config_reload while output buffered or concurrent request presented
fail_closed_contract.atomic_behavior: An illegal condition suppresses request accept and contribution valid/accept in the same cycle, sets sticky protocol_error, and remains quiescent until reset.
fail_closed_contract.legal_reload: config_reload is legal only when the output entry is empty and no request is presented.

decision_rule: The exact-SHA VCS run and all directed/SVA gates must pass. An independent subagent hammer remains mandatory before DC, Formality, PT, paper use, or architectural admission.
red_lines: Do not restore or cite M426 seed-fusion 437,640,532 cycles or 1.695794x.
Do not describe 144 logical or 160 physical bytes per cycle as a free SHARED96 upgrade.
Do not call directed RTL validation full-population or system evidence.
